Message:
ixgbe: fix enum type mismatch on disable laser

Fixes a recent bug on the patch (c6ecf39a10ceec3e97096e2a8d3eadcecd593422)
that disabled the laser on ifconfig down.  Compilers were seeing a enum
mismatch.
